correctness.rationale: The normalized projective-harmonic Jacobi kernel R_{d,k} on projective space has three inner-product values on a union of m MUB:1 within a point,0 within each basis,1/d across bases. Gram decomposes into within-basis zero-sum W, between-basis zero-sum B, total constant C, with eigenvalues 1-u,1+(d-1)u-dv,1+(d-1)u+d(m-1)v. Independently computed exact rational u_k,v_k for k=0,1,2,3 via terminating hypergeometric sum; deduced ranks 1,m(d-1), md-1_{m=d+1},md. Quadratic for m=d has condition number d+1; cubic for m=d+1 has max 9/2 at d=3, formula d(d+4)/((d-2)(d+2)) thereafter. Exact rational checks independently evaluated all k and eigenspaces d=3..17; proof uses algebraic positivity for all allowed d,m, not experiments.
